The bounded interaction is the existing file-size policy owner (countLines, policyForPath and CLI main), fileSizeChangeErrors comparison helper, changedRecords/resolvedCheckBaseCommit range owner, and pre-commit, runFastStatic and pre-push consumers. The owner shape is the existing Git change record with status, oldPath and path plus the per-path scope/threshold policy; no new general domain or debt registry is introduced. Identity is exact Git path/blob content and the declared comparison commit; a byte-identical move can spend one compatible deleted identity once. The range must be resolved before content checks; an unresolved explicit base is unavailable and refuses, never an empty successful diff. These checks read repository state and hold no runtime lease, durable mutation or recovery obligation. Their ordered consequence is pass/refusal before an accepted commit/push; the existing Solver, hooks and Lab scope owners retain commit, proof and process cleanup. Reachable counterexamples are deletion-funded new oversized files, inherited growth, copied/edited identities, out-of-scope moves and a mismatched pushed comparison base, witnessed through the actual checker and caller files. Whole-file runtime-produced receipts are required; expected red assertions and all other observed outcomes remain distinct. Full publication, general measurement-correction policy, Solver package/review binding and distributed service readiness remain outside this bounded claim.
